item.title: America Mints a New National Park, Elevating an Arizonan ‘Sky Island’

item.title: Latest Climate Report Warns of Major Upheaval to California Way of Life
item.description: The dire projections come from the state’s Climate Change Assessment, which analyzes the impacts of changing weather patterns on the nation’s most-populous state.
